style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly resting on a concrete garage floor. Extreme asymmetry framing rule, positioned off-center. The structure features a heavy brushed steel pump manifold with a deep pine green housing, splitting into two distinct brass nozzle channels—one extremely narrow and constricted, the other wide open. Hard clean edges, matte muted palette of graphite, slate grey, and deep pine green. One directional light casting a long, crisp shadow across the weathered concrete surface, generous negative space, no bare shapes, no text, no embossed lettering.
negative_prompt: text, garbled letters, numbers, watermarks, UI, printed lettering
rationale: The story is fundamentally about a mechanical choke point where two numbers trade off. A modular component assembly cleanly isolates this physical reality—a nozzle or valve—without the distraction of a full commercial product.
subject: a brushed steel pump manifold with two distinct brass nozzle channels
core_thesis: Greenworks markets its pressure washers using a peak pressure number and a peak flow number that mathematically and mechanically cannot exist at the same time.
core_conflict: Water pressure versus flow volume trade-off
